chosen_minimal_design.bookkeeping: All required executor pre/post record writes/events and caller safety bookkeeping use the existing nonthrow best-effort sticky-failure helpers. A failed write sets evidence_complete=false/persistence_failure=true but cannot prevent the actual required command. Only fixed fields/hashes/booleans are retained; unknown output/exception strings discarded.
chosen_minimal_design.completion_barrier: Only after all eligible required safety operations for that target have been attempted does a public safety boundary enforce sticky evidence failure as nonzero STOP. It never authorizes later behavior/native collection/coordinator work after IO uncertainty. Main finally still independently attempts each other finalizer, scan, exact resource/secret cleanup and preservation.
chosen_minimal_design.eligibility_order: INSTALL exact source-role absence remains NOT_APPLICABLE without a SQL execution claim. Exact present4 roles use required backend facts then unchanged original source finalizer, or independently verify the already-completed child finalizer. Mixed/unknown/auth-mismatch role state blocks qualification; all other targets still progress.
chosen_minimal_design.finalizer_order: Preserve one actual pre-connection observation→strict typed zero gate→source-pinned original-finalizer command→required post-finalization observer. No REVOKE for active/malformed/unknown precondition or missing/drifted source. Existing postobserver still executes despite write/event failures around the command. A command error remains a failure even if later cleanup state is observed clean; no finalizer SQL retry.
chosen_minimal_design.first_stop_composition: Introduce one tiny same-file explicit exception-preserving closure composition helper/context around existing required closure finally boundaries. Capture the original pending exception, always attempt safety closure, record secondary failure with fixed classes using nonthrow bookkeeping, then rethrow the first exception. Do not rely on sys.exception heuristic or mask an original Stop with a write/closure error. When no earlier exception exists, an invalid or IO-unconfirmed closure raises its fixed STOP before subsequent behavior.
chosen_minimal_design.infile_required_executor: Add the same small reviewed private helper source in each versioned core. It accepts a closed safety operation selector and an already-owned target name only. Role is fixed postgres, original psql transport/private file/immutableCID map and timeout preserved. SQL is selected from existing exact literal recipes or the same-byte source-pinned original finalizer file. No arbitrary SQL, installation mode, expected-error bypass or role parameter.
chosen_minimal_design.no_new_dependency: No new runtime module. One source-only author template and command-only test fixture reproduce identical helper AST in each new core; no project import/helper execution added before existing full source admission.
chosen_minimal_design.normal_sql: Leave existing normal sql()/observe() behavior unchanged: evidence failure stops normal work. No general ignore_io, permissive query flag, arbitrary-role or caller-selected SQL escape hatch.
chosen_minimal_design.required_backend_facts_vs_public_boundar: A private required backend-facts routine performs and records the exact safety observation without throwing solely because persistence failed. Public closed_backends calls it then refuses normal continuation if facts or evidence are unconfirmed. finalize/ensure_original_cleanup use the private facts path so an IO-only failure cannot skip an otherwise-required original-grantor cleanup.
chosen_minimal_design.returned_facts: Actual command must finish with typed integer0 and string response before facts can qualify. Observation responses are bounded, duplicate-free JSON and are checked by exact existing field/type/current-role predicates. Active, malformed, false-as-zero, float, unknown, missing or unobserved backend facts block REVOKE. IO failure does not make backend facts true.
